Location: Hiep Phuoc Industrial Park, Hiep Phuoc commune, Nha Be area, Ho Chi Minh City, on the Soai Rap river — the existing 40,000 DWT petroleum port is being upgraded into a dedicated LNG import terminal ('cảng nhập LNG'): an LNG jetty able to receive LNG carriers of ~10,000-75,000 m³ with marine unloading arms, onshore LNG storage tanks and a regasification system, supplying the co-located Hiep Phuoc LNG-fired power plant (2,700 MW; Phase 1 1,200 MW) and industrial/CNG customers. Distinct site from the Ba Ria-Vung Tau terminals (Cai Mep / Thi Vai); no HCMC terminal previously in GEM. LNG is received by ship at Hiep Phuoc's own jetty (international cargoes and transshipment from Cai Mep) — a marine import terminal, NOT a piped-regas-only power plant.
PowerPlantsSupplied: Hiep Phuoc LNG Power Plant (1,200 MW Phase 1; 2,700 MW total)

LNG import terminal at Hiep Phuoc IP, HCMC (Soai Rap river), integral to the Hiep Phuoc LNG-to-power project (HPPC, chairman Le Van Tam; 2,700 MW / Phase 1 1,200 MW). SCOPE GATE — PASSES as a marine import terminal, and this was resolved BEFORE staging (not stage-with-doubt): the project explicitly upgrades the existing 40,000 DWT petroleum port into a dedicated LNG import port with its own jetty + marine unloading arms + onshore storage + regas, so LNG carriers physically berth and discharge AT Hiep Phuoc.
